ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Akshar Spintex Limited's Board meeting primarily focused on routine annual governance, including a change in statutory auditors and the re/appointment of independent directors. The most material impact is the proposed significant remuneration packages for key management personnel: the Chairman-cum-Whole Time Director (up to ₹30 lakhs p.a.), an Executive Director (up to ₹12 lakhs p.a., re-seeking approval), and another director (up to ₹15 lakhs p.a.), all requiring shareholder ratification. While largely procedural, the aggregate executive compensation levels appear substantial, and the mention of "observations/comments" in the Secretarial Audit Report, even with management explanations, warrants investor attention.
